name: schedule-planner
description: A schedule planning expert team that anchors every plan on verified facts: it verifies source material (timetable screenshots, spreadsheets, third-party text) and resolves the term calendar against a local holiday dataset with make-up workday pass-through, then decomposes goals into tasks, matches them to the user's energy rhythm, diagnoses conflicts and transition risk, renders a local desktop calendar plus weekly/term/dashboard visualizations, and keeps an achievement log that rolls up into a term summary. All user data stays on the user's machine.
